1.consolidated_definition: Coyunto: Persona que mantiene un romance o relación sentimental con una mujer fuera del matrimonio o sin compromiso formal.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Coyunto: A person who maintains a romantic or sentimental relationship with a woman outside of marriage or without formal commitment.

reference_definitions: Coyunto. “Mire usté a lo que se expone una pobre mujer por querer mucho a su coyundo.” Timothee, Celos campestres, 1932.

en_definitions: Coyunto: A person who maintains a romantic or sentimental relationship with a woman outside of marriage or without formal commitment.
